svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle: 900 of pipe. Spider hubs 40 long, at 180 and 780 from the near end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each spider: six spokes 30 x 6, 560 long, every 60 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and six ties 25 x 6 between them at 420 radius (a hexagon).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make a plywood jig with the six spoke lines so both spiders match;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: weld spokes to the hub, then ties, then the hubs to the axle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the spokes of both spiders in line along the axle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill each spoke tip 2 x 10.5 for the carrier bar end plates.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: axle ends in the bushes in the arm blocks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: spoke tips run true within 5 when the axle is spun.
